He bribed officials (tans, Li, Hu) with cash to get the contract without public bidding. So Wu gave bribes to state staff to obtain contract. This is "对单位行贿" (bribing state staff) or "行贿" (bribery). The list includes "对单位行贿" and "受贿". The defendant is the briber, so charge is "对单位行贿". Also possibly "单位行贿"? The list includes both "对单位行贿" and "单位行贿". Here Wu is an individual bribing state staff (state employees). That is "对国家工作人员行贿" maybe "对单位行贿". The list includes "对单位行贿". So answer: [罪名]对单位行贿<eoa>. Possibly also "受贿" is for officials, not for Wu. So only one charge.
